  • Method Details

    • guiEyesAdvanceWithoutWorldTicks

      public static void guiEyesAdvanceWithoutWorldTicks(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The UI clock advances expressions without world ticks. In game: view an animated inventory preview in a pausing screen; its eyes continue expressing while world entities are paused.

    • guiEyesHonorEligibilityAndSwitch

      public static void guiEyesHonorEligibilityAndSwitch(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Disabled and ordinary items retire their old presentation. In game: disable eye animation, then replace a visible eye with a diamond; restoring the eye produces a fresh live presentation.

    • guiEyesKeepPresentationIdentity

      public static void guiEyesKeepPresentationIdentity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Stack copies and count changes preserve a slot's simulation and bounded model identity. In game: split and merge a stack in one slot; its pupil does not restart on each rendered frame.

    • guiEyesReplaceChangedContents

      public static void guiEyesReplaceChangedContents(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A changed appearance invalidates cached draw state. In game: replace a normal eye in one slot with a glowing or dyed copy; its icon immediately shows the new appearance.

    • guiEyesRetireClosedAndHiddenViews

      public static void guiEyesRetireClosedAndHiddenViews(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Closing a view drops its trackers while a visible HUD presentation survives. Hidden icons expire. In game: close a chest, change screens, and scroll creative entries out of view; no old icon state leaks.

    • guiEyesSeparateSlotsAndCursor

      public static void guiEyesSeparateSlotsAndCursor(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Neighboring copies and a carried stack have independent animation and model identities. In game: drag an eye across matching occupied slots; the cursor eye keeps its own expression while moving.

    • guiHeadUsesConfiguredLayout

      public static void guiHeadUsesConfiguredLayout(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      GUI heads retain their actual layout and paired expressions, with GUI gravity on each pupil. In game: place eyed skulls in inventory and a chest; their configured pupils blink and cross-eye at normal icon size, independently of the same heads in frames.
